options.text: Ojas removes an unwanted component (the tea leaves) from the drink.
Charu separates to collect a useful component (the salt).
Both separations have the same purpose: only to throw everything away.
Charu is removing salt as an unwanted waste, not collecting it as useful.

stem:
Ojas strains used tea leaves out of a cup so the drink is clear. Charu evaporates seawater in a shallow dish to collect salt crystals.

What is true about these separations? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Straining tea leaves removes an unwanted part from the drink. Evaporating seawater collects useful salt. The purposes differ.
